title: The Quantum Shortcut: Complex Phase-State Dynamics Reduce the Optimization Steps of Sequence Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.14691v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sequence models are conventionally distinguished by their backbone, the mechanism that routes information across positions, such as attention or recurrence. This paper varies a choice that is prior to the backbone and shared by nearly all current models: the \emph{substrate}, the number system in which the hidden state is represented together with the form of the map from state to prediction. The prevailing substrate is a real-valued state with an affine--softmax readout; we study a complex-valued alternative drawn from the mathematics of quantum theory, in which information is carried by the phases of the state and scores are quadratic Born forms. Prior work proved an idealized version of this substrate representationally stronger than any real model with a linear readout; we ask whether it also trains faster. Relaxing the two properties that block deployment, exact unitarity and the Born vocabulary readout, we instantiate it in the Mam

translated_title: 量子捷径：复杂相位态动力学减少序列模型的优化步骤
translated_abstract: 序列模型通常通过其骨干结构来区分，即跨位置路由信息的机制，如注意力或递归。本文改变了一个先于骨干且几乎所有当前模型共享的选择：\emph{基底}，即隐藏状态表示的数字系统以及从状态到预测的映射形式。主流基底是实值状态，配以仿射-softmax读出；我们研究了一种源自量子理论数学的复值替代方案，其中信息由状态的相位携带，分数为二次Born形式。先前工作证明了这种基底表示的理想化版本在表示能力上强于任何具有线性读出的实模型；我们询问它是否也能训练得更快。通过放宽阻碍部署的两个属性，即严格酉性和Born词汇读出，我们将其实例化于Mam（一种模型架构）中。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于量子理论复值相位态动力学的序列模型基底，通过放宽严格酉性和Born读出约束，在保持表示优势的同时显著减少了优化步骤。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a complex-valued phase-state dynamics substrate for sequence models based on quantum theory, which, by relaxing strict unitarity and Born readout constraints, achieves faster training while retaining representational advantages.
